a.text: I'll operate per our agreement. One concern: with an 80% storm chance each round, we'll probably only get one round, and the reserve can only fill one unit right now. If you want to change the plan, say so openly and we'll decide together. Otherwise I'm sticking to the deal: operate until the reserve holds 8, then take 4 each.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.
